audited_repository.note: curify-studio is a backend/ops monorepo (FastAPI backend curify_background/, static admin_portal/, dev analyst scripts). The actual product frontend (search UI, click handlers, tracking wrapper) lives in a separate sibling repository, curify-frontend, which is NOT part of this audited repository. A limited number of findings cite that sibling repo and are explicitly marked [SECONDARY] throughout the outputs.

secondary_evidence_source.scope_note: Read-only, out-of-scope reference only, cited for essential interpretive context (e.g. frontend conditions under which a SEARCH event fires). Not the primary audited repository. Distinct from and not interacted with: /Users/baobaoli/Desktop/curify-frontend-hybrid-audit (a separate, isolated session's working tree, which this audit did not touch).

method: strict read-only static inspection (find/grep/read only); no code executed, no server started, no SQL executed, no live database connection, no files modified in any repository
research_agent_topics: admin dashboard directories, SQL files, query-builder modules, reporting/cron jobs
click and generation event tracking, generation pipeline entrypoints
database schema (all tables/models), identity/session model, dependencies

key_findings_summary.search_data_storage: Single generic event table user_interactions (curify_background/app/models/interactions.py); no dedicated search_logs/search_history table
key_findings_summary.admin_dashboard: admin_portal/ (static Vite/Tailwind/Chart.js) calling GET /admin/interaction-analytics backed by curify_background/app/crud/admin.py
key_findings_summary.attribution_level_click_to_generate: LEVEL 4 - not reliably attributable (no shared key, no time-window join implemented at all)
key_findings_summary.search_to_generate_direct: LEVEL 4 - only a population-level weekly cohort correlation exists (surface_cohorts)
key_findings_summary.critical_structural_gap: project table (the generation record) has no session_id column, so anonymous generations cannot be linked to any prior anonymous search/click activity
key_findings_summary.search_event_undercounting: [SECONDARY] Healthy, un-narrowed searches with >=5 results never fire any tracked event per curify-frontend evidence, biasing zero-/low-result rate and CTR denominators
key_findings_summary.no_external_analytics_tool: No PostHog/Mixpanel/Amplitude/Segment/ClickHouse/BigQuery used anywhere; all analytics is first-party SQL against Supabase-hosted Postgres
key_findings_summary.no_scheduled_reporting: No cron/pg_cron job computes or refreshes funnel metrics; one materialized view (bot_free_30d) exists but is currently dead code
key_findings_summary.security_note_out_of_scope_but_flagged: curify_background/scripts/migrate_content_type_enum.py contains a hardcoded fallback production Supabase Postgres connection string with an embedded password; value not reproduced in any audit output

limitations: No queries were executed; exact row counts, current CTR/success-rate values, and true search-volume undercount magnitude are not reported, only structural computability
Several findings are cited from the sibling curify-frontend repository, out of the nominal audit scope, and are clearly marked [SECONDARY] throughout
This audit covers only the current main HEAD of a shallow clone; other branches/commits were not inspected
Live production schema was not verified to exactly match the SQLModel class definitions read from source
